meta.title: Francisco Piñero Alpañés
meta.description: Francisco Piñero Alpañés. Software engineer: interfaces that make daily work usable. Alicante.

identity.lead: I build the software people operate with: clear to use, in the flow of work, with AI when it helps.

trajectory.title: Experience
trajectory.lead: From a consultancy in Villena to shipping AI in operations. The through-line is software people can actually use.

consultora.heading: Posiziona TI - web development
consultora.body: Five years across the full cycle: management apps, e-commerce, admin UI. Laravel, Vue, Docker. BSc in Computer Engineering (University of Alicante, Software Engineering). Coffizine, the final project, starts here.

transformacion.heading: Grupo Necomplus / ASEE - digital transformation
transformacion.body: Shipping generative-AI solutions and building the interfaces and internal tools that make them usable. The work was remote; I was already in Alicante.

ahora.heading: The same problem, closer to the interface
ahora.body: I want a similar role in digital transformation and AI, with more weight on interface and UX, room to try things, and a team with a strong technical base. Remote if it is not Alicante; hybrid if the team is here.

work.title: Work
work.lead: What changed for the people who used it.

ai.title: Support that asks, instead of hunting
ai.body: Operations jumped between tickets, wikis, and email. An interface over their own documentation: ask, get an answer, move on.

vision.title: The first field review is done by the system
vision.body: When photographic evidence is required, the system says whether the capture is good enough and why. A person steps in when it fails.

queues.title: From a massive list to the next action
queues.body: Operations stopped deciding case by case on huge queues. The interface applies rules and suggests what to do; people review what does not fit.

delivery.title: Internal products do not invent the path every time
delivery.body: Specify, implement, and ship to the cloud with the same interface standard. The value is team speed.

coffizine.title: Coffizine
coffizine.body: Web forms generated with the people who use them. The point was the interface.

skills.title: Skills
skills.lead: The focus now is the interface. Underneath, there is still a system.
skills.also: Also Vue, APIs, and the path to production.
